        super().__init__()
        # Initialize all registers to their reset values

            0x0E: 0x00,  # OUT_T_H
            0x0F: 0x44,  # WHO_AM_I
            0x20: 0x00,  # CTRL1
            0x21: 0x04,  # CTRL2
            0x23: 0x00,  # CTRL4_INT1_PAD_CTRL
            0x24: 0x00,  # CTRL5_INT2_PAD_CTRL
            0x26: 0x00,  # OUT_T
            0x27: 0x00,  # STATUS
            0x2E: 0x00,  # FIFO_CTRL
            0x2F: 0x00,  # FIFO_SAMPLES
            0x38: 0x00,  # WAKE_UP_SRC
            0x3C: 0x00,  # X_OFS_USR
            0x3D: 0x00,  # Y_OFS_USR
            0x3E: 0x00,  # Z_OFS_USR
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr:#04x}")
        
        value = self.regs[addr]
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF  # Return high byte only
        elif nbytes == 2:
            return value
        else:
            raise ValueError("Invalid nbytes value. Must be 1 or 2.")

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:

            self.regs[0x24] = 0x00
            self.regs[0x3C] = 0x00
            self.regs[0x3D] = 0x00

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:

            return 0
        value = self.regs[addr]

            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF
